style:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: one transparent PNG vocabulary illustration for children aged 3 to 9, shown at 400px square on a grayscale TRMNL e-ink display.
Style: warm friendly flat children's picture-book illustration, uniform solid black contours with rounded joins (12px at 1024 square; interior details 7px). Flat solid fills ONLY white #FFFFFF, light gray #D4D4D4, mid gray #9A9A9A, dark gray #555555 and black #000000. No gradients, texture, soft shading, drop shadows or glow. Simple unmistakable silhouette readable at 2 meters. Center the complete subject in a square, occupying about 80-85% with safe margins on all sides; nothing clipped. TRUE transparent background, opaque white inside white parts of the subject. No ground or scene unless essential to identify the word. No decorative sparkles. No text, letters, digits, labels, logos or watermark. Exactly one illustration, not a sheet or collage. Match How to dress's simple warm black-outlined grayscale illustrations.
Subject:

export.alpha: transparent outside subject; opaque flat fills
export.pipeline: How to dress: normalize canvas and quantize grayscale, preserve raw generations

images.subject: A single large snowflake, exactly six symmetric branches with simple crystalline arms (flocon).
A knitted winter hat with a folded ribbed brim and a large pompom (tuque).
One winter mitten, rounded hand pocket and separate thumb, ribbed cuff (mitaine).
A friendly snowman of three snowballs, carrot-shaped nose, dotted eyes, scarf, two stick arms (bonhomme de neige).
A dome igloo built of visible large snow blocks, small arched entrance (igloo).
One snow shovel, wide scoop, long straight handle and D-shaped grip (pelle).
A cozy masonry fireplace with visible hearth, two logs and simple flames, no room around it (foyer).
A mug filled with hot chocolate, two marshmallows on top and two simple steam curls (chocolat chaud).
One winter boot, thick sole and warm fluffy cuff, three-quarter view (botte).
A friendly North American black bear standing on four paws, rounded ears, broad snout, medium-dark gray fur, not a polar bear (ours).
One ice skate with a lace-up boot and a clearly visible single metal blade below, no wheels (patin).
A simple child sled with a molded shallow seat, raised front, short pull rope, no reindeer (luge).
One bold simple heart shape, light gray fill and black outline, the familiar love symbol, not anatomy (cœur).
images.prompt_override: Use case: precise-object-edit. Fix the attached heart vocabulary illustration. Preserve the familiar symmetrical Valentine heart OUTER silhouette, but replace the ENTIRE INTERIOR with ONE completely uniform solid opaque LIGHT GRAY #D4D4D4 fill. Add one strong clean uniform black outline around the OUTER edge. There must be NO hole, no transparency anywhere inside the heart, NO inner border, NO other heart shape inside, NO shading, gradient, shadow, highlight, texture or central marks. It must look like a simple filled flat heart cutout in a children's picture book. Keep the background outside the heart genuinely transparent. Centered square composition with safe margins. No face, eyes, mouth, lettering, symbols or embellishments. Precisely one solid light gray heart, thick black contour, transparent outside only.

A thin French crêpe folded into a triangle on a simple plate, second folded edge visible, no syrup bottle (crêpe).
images.prompt_override: Use case: precise-object-edit. Replace the folded triangular French crepe on this plate with THREE ROUND PANCAKE-STYLE CREPES stacked neatly on a simple round plate, seen in three-quarter view. Round discs, slightly puffy but still breakfast pancakes, with a small flat dark-gray drizzle of maple syrup on top. ADD a small upright glass maple-syrup bottle immediately BESIDE the plate, fully visible, with a short neck, cap and a simple maple-leaf symbol on its front, no text or brand. Composition: plate and round pancakes on the left, bottle on the right, both together centered in a square with generous safe margins. Preserve the reference's warm children's picture-book style, bold rounded black outlines and flat grayscale palette ONLY white #FFFFFF, light gray #D4D4D4, mid gray #9A9A9A, dark gray #555555, black #000000. TRUE transparent background outside the plate and bottle, opaque flat fills inside. No faces, eyes or mouths on food or objects. No triangular folded crepe, no extra utensils, butter, fruit, scenery, labels, letters, gradients, shading, texture or watermark.
